verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single line on the Pipecat Cloud pricing page. It lists Krisp-powered noise cancellation that removes background noise and voices causing false interruptions, so it is a product-offered capability, but only thinly evidenced. Missing for 10: documentation on how a developer enables or configures noise suppression or audio filters in the pipeline, evidence it is available in open-source or self-hosted Pipecat beyond Cloud, other filter options, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it keeps the agent coherent on noisy calls.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enable noise suppression or audio filtering so the agent stays coherent on noisy real-world calls

citations.quote: Eliminates background noise and voices that cause false interruptions, powered by Krisp.
